objective: Correlate HTTPS, TLS, HTTP, QUIC, and conventional DNS evidence to distinguish approved encrypted resolution from policy bypass or suspicious resolver use without claiming DNS content that encryption makes unavailable.
preconditions: a trusted client endpoint and bounded HTTPS flow window exist
TLS HTTP or QUIC metadata is attributable
deployed DNS TLS and HTTP field catalogs are available
required_evidence: TLS or QUIC server identity and flow tuple
HTTP method URI or media metadata when observable
conventional DNS baseline resolver policy and telemetry coverage
positive_evidence: visible HTTP metadata identifies a standards-conformant DNS-over-HTTPS exchange to an attributable resolver
resolver identity and repeated client behavior contradict approved endpoint policy with corroborating flow evidence
negative_evidence: successful covered telemetry attributes the service to an approved resolver and client policy
visible HTTPS metadata does not support DoH and conventional DNS activity explains the same bounded client window
escalation_pivots: correlate TLS or QUIC identity with visible HTTP metadata
compare conventional DNS activity for the exact client and window
obtain current endpoint resolver policy before escalating suspected bypass

query_templates.purpose: Identify the bounded TLS or QUIC service endpoint without inferring encrypted DNS payload content.
Retrieve bounded HTTP metadata that can support or refute a DoH exchange when visible.
Compare attributable conventional DNS activity without treating its absence as proof of DoH.

alternative_hypotheses: approved browser or operating-system encrypted DNS
ordinary HTTPS to shared resolver infrastructure
privacy or security software using an authorized resolver
policy bypass or malware using encrypted resolution
stop_conditions: resolver identity client policy and corroborating protocol metadata discriminate the hypotheses
encrypted fields remain unavailable and are reported as such
a wider pivot has low expected information value
a query budget or deadline is exhausted
confidence_limiters: encrypted DNS payload is not observable
HTTP metadata unavailable for HTTP2 or QUIC
endpoint resolver policy unavailable or stale
known_false_positive_patterns: approved security agents and VPN clients
